title: Count Substrings That Satisfy K-Constraint I
summary: Given a binary string s and an integer k , count the number of substrings of s that satisfy the k-constraint.
statement: Given a binary string s and an integer k , count the number of substrings of s that satisfy the k-constraint. A binary string satisfies the k-constraint if the number of 0's in the string is at most k or the number of 1's in the string is at most k .
constraints: A binary substring satisfies the k-constraint when its zero count is at most k or its one count is at most k.
The logical condition is inclusive OR; only substrings with both counts above k fail.
Return the number of nonempty satisfying substrings.
hints: Enumerate each start under the source-I constraints.
Extend the endpoint while maintaining zero and one counts.
Count the substring when either count is at most k.
Every substring is visited once and its maintained counts make the stated Boolean test exact.
editorial: Every substring is visited once and its maintained counts make the stated Boolean test exact.
